Self-contained integration fixtures

The catalog retains gameplay fields from the bundled demo and adds five invented
commanders plus 90 invented spells covering ramp, draw, removal, wipes, threats
and utility. Invented definitions begin with "Fixture"; they are not real cards.
The five deck lists are synthetic 100-card test inputs, not commercial precons.
All images are locally authored SVG test patterns, not card artwork.
No network, user collection, credentials or historic CLI snapshot is required.
Catalog source: data/demo-catalog/oracle_cards.json, plus synthetic test records.
The minimal Zaxara deck checks legacy import independently of historical outputs.
